description: Memory extraction test set, hand-labelled before any model saw it. Each row is what the user wrote in one turn. `durable` says whether anything in it is worth remembering after the conversation ends. `type` is the kind of memory it holds when it is durable: a preference (how the user likes things), a fact (something true about the user or their world), a procedure (how to do a task, step by step or as a standing rule) or an event (something that happened or is scheduled).

types.preference: how the user likes things done: tastes, styles, choices, things to avoid
types.fact: something true about the user, the people they work with or their world
types.procedure: how to do a task: steps to follow, or a standing rule for a kind of request
types.event: something that happened or is scheduled, with a time
